items.title: AWS Introduces Preview of Well-Architected Agent
items.blurb: AWS recently announced the preview of the Well-Architected Agent, a service that analyzes environments against Well-Architected best practices and provides prioritized recommendations across cost, security, performance, and reliability.

items.title: Amazon Time Sync Service adds support for microsecond-accurate time on 135 additional EC2 instance types in all commercial regions
items.blurb: Amazon Time Sync Service introduces support for microsecond-accurate time on 135 additional EC2 instance types—spanning 12 instance families—in all commercial regions.

items.title: AWS Transform for full-stack Windows modernization now supports Aurora PostgreSQL cross-region deployment in 7 more Regions
items.blurb: Today, AWS Transform for full-stack Windows modernization adds support for cross-region deployment of converted Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL databases and is available in seven additional AWS Regions.

items.title: Amazon MSK Connect and AWS Glue Schema Registry are now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon MSK Connect and the AWS Glue Schema Registry are available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region.

items.title: Amazon CloudFront announces dual-stack support for VPC origins
items.blurb: Amazon CloudFront now supports end-to-end IPv6 delivery to origins inside your Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC), with the new dual-stack VPC origins.

items.title: PostgreSQL 19 RC1 is now available in Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 19 Release Candidate 1 (RC1) is available in the Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment , allowing you to evaluate the pre-release of PostgreSQL 19 on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL.

items.title: Amazon Redshift long-term system table retention with Amazon S3 Tables is now available in additional AWS Regions
items.blurb: Amazon Redshift long-term retention for system table data through native integration with Amazon S3 Tables is now available in additional AWS Regions.
